name: Use official Ubuntu package mirrors
Locate Composer cache
Configure Flux Composer auth
Install PHP dependencies
Install Node dependencies
Verify Team preservation and work contracts with synthetic data
Verify Teams scanner protocol and operator script contracts
Prepare safe PDF conversion
run:
if ! command -v gs >/dev/null; then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ghostscript
fi
echo "WHOLESALE_LABEL_GS=$(command -v gs)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

name: Build pinned custom-label vector tracer
run:
rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
CARGO_BUILD_TARGET=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_MUSL_LINKER=rust-lld scripts/labels/install-vtracer.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/label-tools"
sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/label-tools/vtracer-0.6.5" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/label-tools/vtracer-0.6.5.sha256"
echo "WHOLESALE_LABEL_VTRACER=$RUNNER_TEMP/label-tools/vtracer-0.6.5" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

run:
set -euo pipefail

if [ -z "$base_sha" ]; then
  base_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD^)"
fi
echo "sha=$base_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
